web_evidence.title: Handle with Care | Book by Jodi Picoult | Official Publisher Page
web_evidence.note: The authorized publisher excerpt labels Charlotte as speaker and sustains participating narration through my and I while addressing Willow as you.

web_evidence.title: Jodi Picoult · Handle With Care
web_evidence.note: The author's long authorized February 2005 excerpt rotates through Amelia, Sean, Charlotte, and Piper; each named character narrates participating experience as I while calling Willow you.

web_evidence.title: A conversation with Jodi Picoult about Handle With Care
web_evidence.note: Picoult explains that multiple narrators tell their own stories directly to Willow throughout the novel. Under this task's narrator-participation definition, the storytellers are first-person narrators and Willow is their second-person narratee.

web_evidence.title: Handle with Care by Jodi Picoult
web_evidence.note: Publishers Weekly corroborates the whole-book structure of alternating narrator voices but does not independently specify their grammatical person.

web_evidence.title: Book Review - Handle with Care by Jodi Picoult
web_evidence.note: This review confirms that chapters change voice and that every narrator's you is Willow. It calls that address second person, but does not negate the excerpts' participating I narrators under the methodology used here.

person_note: The controlling narration is delivered by multiple participating character-narrators, all using I; multiple first-person narrators remain FIRST. Their recurring you addresses Willow, the central narratee, and does not replace the storytellers with a second-person protagonist for this methodology. The numerous interior quote passages independently expose I/we narration, while two authorized Tier A excerpts show the same form in the opening and across a sustained multi-voice section. Apparent contrary descriptions calling the book second person refer to its direct-address device and are therefore terminological rather than structural conflict. No material uncertainty remains about narrator participation.
